'''Troll ranger commandos''' were ranger trolls wandering around [[Burthorpe]] and [[Taverley]]. They were sometimes found with the [[Troll commando]]s and [[Troll mage commando]]s. They dropped the [[Arrowstorm drape]] and [[Quickbow]].

They were replaced with [[White wolf (Burthorpe)|White wolves]], which have the same stats and drops.
